item.text: {"analysis":"The supplied failures show repeated damage on both orb legs. StepShots checks m.hit.Contains(u), but clears the set on collision instead of recording the target. Add each collided target to the set; the existing clear at turnaround permits one new hit on the return leg. Swept segment collision remains unchanged. This proposal has not yet been verified by the host.","edits":[{"path":"Assets/Dex/Runtime/DexArena.cs","find":"if(m.owner.f.champion==\"Ezreal\"&&m.slot==1&&u.minion)continue;m.hit.Clear();","replace":"if(m.owner.f.champion==\"Ezreal\"&&m.slot==1&&u.minion)continue;m.hit.Add(u);","create":false}]}
